entities.summary: Sumaya Awad is a Palestinian American writer and activist based in New York City. She directs strategy and communications for the Adalah Justice Project, and co-edited the book Palestine: A Socialist Introduction, published in 2020. Sumaya Awad was a activists & reformers (b. 1901). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
